summary.headline: Sphere Corp. corrects contract filing: KRW 2.65bn special alloy supply deal with US space launch firm
summary.what_happened: Sphere Corp. filed a correction to its earlier single supply contract disclosure, reporting that a special alloy supply contract with a US global aerospace launch company has been fully performed and paid, and that the contract end date is revised from Dec 14, 2026 to Nov 23, 2026. The contract value is stated as KRW 2,650,380,376 (USD 1,828,605.2, converted at 1,449.40 KRW/USD), and the company states that its counterparty's trade secret protections mean only summary information will continue to be disclosed.

key_numbers.label: Ratio to recent revenue (as stated in filing)

summary.why_it_matters: Single supply contract disclosures in Korea inform shareholders of the size, timing and status of a company's individual sales deals, which can help them assess the scale of specific orders relative to reported revenue. Corrections to such filings typically update performance status, payment completion or schedule changes that were previously disclosed.
